source_note: Implementation is pinned by implementation_commit; git_head is the pre-commit base of the initial run. Corrected CuPy rows retain prior attempts. This report combines sequential runs with identical matrix hashes and acceptance gates.
reference_settings: CuPy LOBPCG absolute tol=1e-8; CuPy eigsh/svds tol=1e-11. Connection ring n=1024 uses ncv=64 after ncv=32 exhausted its budget; all actual ncv values are per row.
